scope: scripts/qualify_hardware_changes.py --slice refusals on a frozen Debug build of 45f7155d (artifacts/rf3, git archive), 199/199 steps, in two owned scratch projects created through the MCP Host, one owned TIA Portal V21 each. First: an owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 and an added CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 on one subnet, two DI 16x24VDC HF in the scratch rack, an ET 200SP IM 155-6 PN ST V6.4 station assigned to the added CPU (creating HwPeerIo) with three DI 8x24VDC ST (6ES7 131-6BF00-0BA0 V1.1), and the operator-installed I-device GSD device on HwPeerIo. Applied with asserted preview, checkpoint, device compile, save and exact state deltas: a DI 16x24VDC HF replaced by a DI 32x24VDC HF V2.2 with acceptAddressChange and one acknowledged tag, the tagged range's start moving from byte 0 to 4 past the next module (refused as AddressReferenced first, restored after); the sharedDevice disconnect of the scratch CPU's connector with its one assigned DI module given back to the added CPU in the same change (restored after); OutsideOfProject with one external IO controller. Typed refusals, each by its exact code and rule message with the complete state unchanged: network_mrp_set Manager while the CPUs' Port_2 link joins non-ring ports and NotInRing while it joins two ring ports (NetworkPrerequisite), a direct PLC-to-PLC hardware_shared_device_access (UnsupportedCapability), a channel InputDelay write the DI 8x24VDC ST capability profile declares read-only and an InformationText write the GSD head's bundled versionless profile (keyed by FirmwareVersion V4.1) does not declare (AttributeNotWritable); hardware_catalog_search named that GSD profile. Second: a new owned scratch whose own CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 assigns the same ET 200SP station (same device name and address) with the same modules, two of them OutsideOfProject with two external IO controllers; the runner compared both stations: each module has the same type and slot and is PLC-owned in exactly one project.
limitations: Engineering only, offline: nothing is downloaded, no PLCSIM, no physical topology or MRP telegram is observed.
A versionless firmware matching no profile (fail closed) is not exercised natively: the installed GSD has one DAP with one firmware (offline tests cover it).

The sharedDevice disconnect with one remaining PLC and one assigned module; more remaining PLCs are refused and not exercised. The disconnect, the address change and the shared device are restored, not persisted across a reopen (the slice has no reopen).

Second project: V21 checks nothing across projects; the runner compares the two stations. Head, interface, ports and server module stay assigned in both projects, which a downloaded configuration would have to resolve; SharedDeviceCopyOfModule is not configured.
The address change rewrites no tag address and does not search absolute %I/%Q accesses in program code.

Earlier passes, not evidence: discovery rd1 (artifacts/rf1, ae11ebcb; it found the disconnect compile failure fixed in c0d006b6, and a stray second discovery pass of the same build ran from a stopped lock waiter), and rq1 (artifacts/rf2, c0d006b6; stopped on an unlisted change of the leaving CPU's interface row, fixed in the runner in 45f7155d).
